files.README.md:
# mongorust-mongodb-validators-dtos

Data access layer generated by [DB2CRUD](https://github.com/RaulEstevezA/DB2CRUD) for a database that already exists: plain entities, repositories and services with the MongoDB driver, in asynchronous Rust. It does not create or migrate the database, and it depends on no web framework.

## Settings

- Database: mongodb.
- Entities: written for the tables the input had no type for.
- Services: take and return DTOs; updates take every field that can change; errors are `Result<T, DomainError>`.
- Transactions: one transaction per service operation, committed when it ends.
- Lists: lists return pages after a key (cursor).

## Layout

```text
src/database.rs          the connection of DATABASE_URL
src/bson_values.rs       values of documents, and what changed in one
src/unit_of_work.rs      the repositories of every table, and the transactions
src/errors.rs            DomainError: NotFound, Conflict, ValidationFailed, Database; no HTTP codes
src/entities/            one entity per collection
src/repositories/        the repositories of each table
src/services/            one service per table
tests/data/              repositories against a database, services on the in-memory repositories
crud-contract.json       what was written, for CRUD2Controller
```

## Running the tests

```bash
TEST_DATABASE_URL="mongodb://localhost:27017/app" cargo test   # a real, disposable database: it is emptied
```

Look for `TODO` in the code: each one marks a decision the input did not settle.

//! What the service of patients takes and returns.

/// The values of a new Patient. Fields left None take the database's default; the service says which ones are required.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default, PartialEq)]
pub struct PatientCreate {
    pub name: Option<String>,
    pub birth: Option<chrono::DateTime<chrono::Utc>>,
    pub weight: Option<f64>,
    pub balance: Option<rust_decimal::Decimal>,
    pub document: Option<String>,
    pub photo: Option<Vec<u8>>,
    pub visits: Option<i32>,
    pub blood: Option<String>,
    pub contacts: Option<Vec<crate::entities::patient::PatientContact>>,
    pub insurance: Option<crate::entities::patient::PatientInsurance>,
    pub version: Option<i32>,
}

/// A Patient as services return it.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq)]
pub struct PatientRead {
    pub id: String,
    pub name: String,
    pub birth: chrono::DateTime<chrono::Utc>,
    pub weight: Option<f64>,
    pub balance: Option<rust_decimal::Decimal>,
    pub document: Option<String>,
    pub photo: Option<Vec<u8>>,
    pub visits: i32,
    pub blood: Option<String>,
    pub contacts: Vec<crate::entities::patient::PatientContact>,
    pub insurance: Option<crate::entities::patient::PatientInsurance>,
    pub version: Option<i32>,
}

/// The values of a Patient that change: every field is replaced.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq)]
pub struct PatientUpdate {
    pub name: String,
    pub birth: chrono::DateTime<chrono::Utc>,
    pub weight: Option<f64>,
    pub balance: Option<rust_decimal::Decimal>,
    pub document: Option<String>,
    pub photo: Option<Vec<u8>>,
    pub visits: i32,
    pub blood: Option<String>,
    pub contacts: Vec<crate::entities::patient::PatientContact>,
    pub insurance: Option<crate::entities::patient::PatientInsurance>,
    pub version: Option<i32>,
}
